title: End-to-end persistent semantic selective computation
question: Can a runtime combine noisy persistent-state addressing, candidate retention, and batched execution while preserving capability and making execution work depend on a fixed relevant subset rather than H?
hypothesis: H_end_to_end: with M=64 persistent semantic state items and R=4 relevant programs held fixed, the indexed runtime will preserve the exhaustive capability while state and execution work remain bounded and exhaustive execution work grows with H.

arms.name: exhaustive
arms.intervention: full H-state scan, full H candidate matching, execute all H programs

arms.name: selective
arms.intervention: Hamming state index, exact candidate index, execute only retained R=4 programs

endpoints.name: success_rate
endpoints.role: primary — aggregate output matches hidden environment truth

endpoints.name: executor_calls
endpoints.role: secondary — actual number of candidate programs executed

endpoints.name: state_address_work
endpoints.role: secondary — exhaustive scan vs indexed probes

endpoints.name: candidate_address_work
endpoints.role: secondary — exhaustive candidate matching vs indexed positions

endpoints.name: state_index_retention
endpoints.role: secondary — target state survives approximate state index

endpoints.name: candidate_index_retention
endpoints.role: secondary — all relevant programs survive candidate index

decision_rule.condition: selective success_rate equals exhaustive success_rate at every H; selective executor work equals 12R; exhaustive executor work equals 12H; target state and all four relevant candidates are retained in every cell
decision_rule.licenses: bounded support for the combined persistent selective-computation runtime: execution work depends on R while capability is preserved under the registered synthetic task
decision_rule.does_not_license: general semantic memory, learned indexing, hardware superiority, or the full L4 C5 claim

decision_rule.condition: selective success_rate is lower than exhaustive at any H or relevant execution work exceeds 12R
decision_rule.licenses: the registered end-to-end selective runtime does not preserve capability/work isolation under this task

held_constant: 10-bit state codebook and exactly one flipped query bit
state index Hamming radius=2 and state shortlist=1
candidate population uses four programs per state code
query targets one of the first 16 state codes and therefore exactly four relevant programs exist at every H
candidate index is built once per static population and queried for each evaluation task
same fixed-work executor is used by exhaustive and selective arms
no learning or repair is used in this runtime experiment
